text:
sam_devex: Heads-up — I'm kicking off the SDK publish pipeline tonight at 23:30 PST for Python and TypeScript. Plan: canary -> QA -> staggered rollout. Quick checklist in thread so we have a record.

release-bot: scheduled publish job queued: job_id=rb-1834567890-1

jana_eng: ack. small requests: 1) ensure py wheels are built with `--plat-name manylinux2014` 2) pin sync-client 0.16.x for downstream customers for 7 days 3) include signer hash in release metadata.

sam_devex: adding signer hash step to checklist. will add pin note to release PR.

deploy-bot: publish started: npm:redwood-sdk@0.17.0-canary, pypi:redwood-sdk-py-0.17.0rc1. logs: `uploading artifacts -> checksum ok`

liam_sre: Can we disable streaming in the TS canary? We've seen flaky socket closes during midnight runs. add `STREAMING=false` env for canary.

sam_devex: done. env flag set for canary job.

maria_prod: timeline question — when do we push the deprecation note for the legacy sync client? ops: we should surface a banner in Console + note in CHANGELOG at GA.

alex_docs: I'll draft a short deprecation blurb. Proposed: "Legacy sync client will be deprecated on 2026-04-30; upgrade to new async client. See migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/sdk-migrate"

sam_devex: looks good, include migration snippet and known breaking changes (session token format).

qa-bot: canary smoke results: python smoke OK (5/5), typescript smoke FAIL (2/5) — failing on streaming handshake. Investigating.

liam_sre: that's expected given we toggled streaming off but some integration tests assume it. QA: rerun tests with `STREAMING=false` to validate.

qa-bot: rerun queued; results: TS smoke OK (5/5).

deploy-bot: publish succeeded to npm registry. PyPI propagation in progress (may take up to 5 minutes). artifact_signer=sha256:3a7f...c9e1

jana_eng: confirming signer hash matches staging mirror. All good. Also added post-release pin on docs for 7 days (`x-pinned: sync-client:0.16.x`).

sam_devex: rollout plan: canary -> 10% (2hr) -> 50% (4hr) -> 100% (monitoring). If we see a regression in quality metrics or signer mismatch, immediate rollback to 0.16.x and create hotfix branch.

maria_prod: noted. For rollback, please have the rollback PR template ready and notify #incidents and CSMs.

sam_devex: preparing rollback PR template now. snippet:```bash
# rollback script
npm dist-tag add redwood-sdk@0.16.5 stable
python -m pip install redwood-sdk-py==0.16.5
```

release-bot: canary Metrics: latency + token-cost dashboards created: dashboards/d-1834567890-canary. Alert rule: error-rate > 1.5% for 10m triggers paging.

sam_devex: copying dashboard link into release notes draft. Follow-ups: 1) post release notes to #announcements at 09:00 PT tomorrow, 2) prod CSM notify for large customers, 3) add migration howto to docs and link in PR.

alex_docs: will have docs PR up in next 2 hours, will include code examples and a migration checklist.

jana_eng: thanks — once GA is stable we should schedule the deprecation banner rollout for 2026-04-01 internal preview then public on 2026-04-15.

sam_devex: closing thread — canary passed, staggered rollout started. If anything pops, ping me or tag `@sam_devex` in thread. :thumbsup:
